id: 12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety
title: 激光设备的紧急停机（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，一手指着红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large laser cutting machine, pointing at a red emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：激光设备怎么紧急停机。

shots.scene: 地垫、急停按钮、总闸三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a floor safety mat, a red emergency stop button, and a main disconnect switch. No people.
shots.narration: 地垫、按钮、总闸，三道保险。

shots.scene: 小研带着几位新同学走进激光加工实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads a few new students into a laser processing lab.
shots.narration: 小研带新同学来看激光切割。

shots.scene: 切割头突然冒出一团火光，新同学愣在原地
shots.prompt_en: A sudden flash and puff of smoke appears at the cutting head, and a new student freezes in place.
shots.narration: 切割头突然冒火，新同学愣住了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前举起三根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 这时该按哪里？我们一样一样说。

shots.scene: 老李在实验室门口欢迎参观的同学
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer welcomes visiting students at the lab door.
shots.narration: 来参观的人都想看激光，很欢迎。

shots.scene: 老李走在参观队伍旁边，伸手示意大家靠拢
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks beside the group of visitors, gesturing for them to stay together.
shots.narration: 带人进来，就要照看好每一个。

shots.scene: 几个同学弯腰凑到激光机前往里看
shots.prompt_en: Several students lean forward toward the front of the laser cutting machine to look inside.
shots.narration: 走到机器前，人人都想凑近看。

shots.scene: 激光机前铺着一条长长的黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: A long black safety floor mat lies along the front of the laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机器前面，铺着一条安全地垫。

shots.scene: 示意图：脚踩上地垫，机器所有运动图标停止
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a foot steps on the safety mat and all motion icons of the machine stop at once. No people.
shots.narration: 一脚踩上去，整台机器马上停。

shots.scene: 地垫图标和盾牌图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the safety mat linked to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它是机器上最重要的保护之一。

shots.scene: 操作台上并排一个红色急停按钮和一个黄色快停按钮
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button and a yellow feed hold button side by side on the control panel. No people.
shots.narration: 操作台上有两种停机按钮。

shots.scene: 机器末端也有一个快停按钮
shots.prompt_en: Another feed hold button mounted at the far end of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机器末端，也装着快停按钮。

shots.scene: 按下快停，龙门架停住，电源指示灯仍亮
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: pressing the feed hold stops the moving gantry while the power indicator lights stay on. No people.
shots.narration: 快停只让机器停止运动。

shots.scene: 停住的龙门架旁，电源柜仍带电的闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A paused gantry next to a power cabinet that still shows a lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电源和高压，其实还开着。

shots.scene: 老李按下红色蘑菇头急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a red mushroom-head emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 急停按钮不一样。

shots.scene: 示意图：驱动、高压、激光三个图标同时熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: three icons turn off at the same time: drive motors, high voltage, and laser. No people.
shots.narration: 一按下去，驱动、高压全部断开。

shots.scene: 新同学站在冒烟的机器旁一脸慌张
shots.prompt_en: A new student stands beside a smoking machine, looking confused and scared.
shots.narration: 出了事故，新手不知道怎么办，

shots.scene: 老李快步走向墙边的总隔离开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks quickly past tanks and a chiller to a main disconnect switch on the wall.
shots.narration: 就去拉下墙上的总隔离开关。

shots.scene: 总闸、激光电源柜、冷水机、储罐图标连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a main disconnect switch connected in a chain to a laser power cabinet, a chiller, and support equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 激光器、冷水机都从这里供电。

shots.scene: 拉下总闸，所有设备图标一起熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the main disconnect lever is pulled down and all the equipment icons go dark together. No people.
shots.narration: 一拉，所有设备一起断电。

shots.scene: 一个人头上冒问号，旁边的总闸图标发亮
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with a question mark above the head next to a glowing main disconnect switch icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还要停下来想一想？

shots.scene: 老李握住总闸手柄，坚定地点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer grips the main disconnect handle and nods firmly.
shots.narration: 那就别犹豫，直接拉闸。

shots.scene: 王老师带着检查表，踩地垫测试机器是否停下
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank checklist while stepping on the safety mat to test that the machine stops.
shots.narration: 地垫、急停要定期测试。

shots.scene: 老李按下急停后核对指示灯，在空白记录本上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the emergency stop, checks the indicator lights, and ticks a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 试一次，记一次。

shots.scene: 失灵的急停按钮上挂着停用牌，旁边扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A faulty emergency stop button with a blank out-of-service tag hanging on it, next to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 失灵了立刻停用，报修。

shots.scene: 用胶带缠住急停、用重物压住地垫的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons crossed out with red X marks: tape wrapped over an emergency stop button and a heavy box pressing on a safety mat. No people.
shots.narration: 不准屏蔽、绕过停机装置。

shots.scene: 王老师组织同学演练：小研按急停，阿杰去拉总闸
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator runs a drill: the female graduate student presses the emergency stop and the young male student goes to the main disconnect.
shots.narration: 平时多演练，谁按哪个要清楚。

shots.scene: 演练后，同学们围在王老师身边打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: After the drill, the students gather around the safety administrator, and one of them makes a phone call to report.
shots.narration: 停机后，马上报告老师。

shots.scene: 电话图标显示119和120
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon with two emergency number icons, 119 and 120. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现地垫、急停、总闸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a safety mat, an emergency stop button, and a main disconnect switch.
shots.narration: 地垫一踩停，急停全断开。

shots.scene: 快停和总闸两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a yellow feed hold button and a main disconnect switch with a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 快停只停运动，拿不准就拉总闸。

shots.scene: 检查表和演练的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank checklist and a group drill. No people.
shots.narration: 定期测试，经常演练。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、老李、王老师在激光机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student, the facility engineer and the safety administrator beside the laser machine.
shots.narration: 关键时刻，停得下来才安全。
